Sunday Pantry

Social + Ads2026

One breakfast brand. Several reasons to stop scrolling.

STATUS
Self-initiated concept
ROLE
Art direction, design and production study
OUTPUT
Editable vector layouts / PDF

CONTEXT / PROBLEM

Product, offer and educational messages need different layouts without losing campaign consistency.

Creative direction

Rust, cream and dark brown meet warm product imagery. Serif headlines slow the pace; bold sans makes offers direct.

The system

Three feed posts, two three-card carousels, three stories, four ads, two LinkedIn graphics and two thumbnails.

PRODUCTION / DELIVERY

Made to be used again.

Twenty-one editable layouts including reuse rules. AI-generated product imagery. Canva-ready concept, not a live Canva link.

Design outcome

The finished study demonstrates a repeatable design system and production-aware decisions. No measured business result is claimed.
